title: Unifying Generative Models with Path Integrals
abstract: arXiv:2608.12438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We formulate generative modeling as a path integral in which flow-based, diffusion-based, variational, and adversarial models arise as different evaluation principles for a single master action. Its Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) form separates free from interacting probability flows and opens them to diagrammatic perturbation theory. The expansion yields a one-loop correction to deterministic samplers at no stochastic-sampling cost, which we validate on solvable and nonlinear drifts, where it reduces a 53 % tree-level error to 1.6 %. Imperfect learned scores enter as insertions and yield a response-weighted score-matching objective, and symmetry-equivariant drift design becomes an operator expansion with EFT power counting.

translated_title: 用路径积分统一生成模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12438v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们将生成建模表述为一个路径积分，其中基于流、基于扩散、变分和对抗模型作为单一主作用量的不同评估原则出现。其Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de-Dominicis（MSRJD）形式将自由概率流与相互作用概率流分离，并使其适用于图解微扰理论。该展开对确定性采样器提供了一环修正，且无需随机采样成本，我们在可解和非线性漂移上验证了这一点，将53%的树级误差降至1.6%。不完美的学习得分作为插入项出现，产生响应加权的得分匹配目标，而对称等变漂移设计成为具有EFT幂次计数的算子展开。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一的路径积分框架，将多种生成模型整合于单一作用量，并通过微扰理论实现无额外采样成本的高精度修正，显著降低生成误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified path integral framework that integrates various generative models into a single action, and achieves high-precision corrections without extra sampling cost via perturbation theory, significantly reducing generation errors.
